entities.name: Lluwen
entities.description: An elf druid from Lorwyn-Shadowmoor and Witherbloom student at Strixhaven; a Faultless elf who prefers animals to people.

entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: A vampire captured by Lluwen in the Gilt-Leaf Wood.

entities.name: Morcant
entities.description: High Perfect who sought to destroy Shadowmoor and poison Isilu with dawnglow.

entities.name: Isilu
entities.description: A great elemental prematurely awakened by the students.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: Planeswalker who rescued Kirol and is associated with Professor Liliana Vess.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Professor of the Magibotanical Environments class.

entities.name: Sanar
entities.description: Classmate who returned with Kirol and Ajani.

entities.name: Tamira
entities.description: Suggested Lluwen join Strixhaven's cross-planar program.

entities.name: Tam
entities.description: Friend who accompanied Lluwen to Titan's Grave and cast herself and Jadzi into wild magic.

entities.name: Professor Fel
entities.description: Professor who rescued Lluwen and Kirol from a daemogoth trap.

entities.name: Jadzi
entities.description: Oracle abducted by the Dawning Archaic who performed a ritual to calm it.

entities.name: Dawning Archaic
entities.description: An Archaic emitting reality-warping magic, finally encased by the students' unity.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker who confronted Lluwen, blaming Jace.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker blamed by Chandra for disrupting the Archaics.

entities.name: Strixhaven University
entities.description: University on Arcavios where Lluwen studies.

entities.name: Titan's Grave
entities.description: Site of the excursion and the chasm.

events.summary: Lluwen captures the vampire Kirol in the Gilt-Leaf Wood and brings them to High Perfect Morcant.
events.quote: Lluwen captured the vampire Kirol in the Gilt-Leaf Wood

events.summary: Morcant plans to poison Isilu with dawnglow, but Kirol and Ajani flee and later return to steal the dawnglow from her.
events.quote: stole the dawnglow from her, transforming her into her Shadowmoor aspect in the process

events.summary: Lluwen joins Strixhaven's cross-planar student program at Tamira's suggestion and enters Witherbloom.
events.quote: Lluwen joined Strixhaven's cross-planar student program to escape the ruthless elven hierarchy of Lorwyn

events.summary: Lluwen witnesses the Archaics' ritual and the abduction of Oracle Jadzi, then is confronted by Chandra Nalaar.
events.quote: the subsequent abduction of Oracle Jadzi by the Dawning Archaic

events.summary: The students and planeswalkers fall into a chasm beneath Titan's Grave.
events.quote: fell into a chasm beneath Titan's Grave along with it

events.summary: Professor Fel rescues Lluwen and Kirol from a daemogoth trap.
events.quote: before they were rescued by Professor Fel

events.summary: Tam casts Jadzi and herself into wild magic, vanishing; Lluwen finishes the ritual and encases the Archaic.
events.quote: Lluwen was forced to finish the ritual himself

relations.quote: a Witherbloom student at Strixhaven University
along with Lluwen's help, stole the dawnglow from her
they were saved by the intervention of Ajani Goldmane
Kirol and Ajani fled the forest, and Lluwen decided to follow.
